answers.1_supports_native_json: Yes, llama-3.3-70b-versatile supports native JSON mode. Qwen models and gpt-oss-20b failed native mode (PermissionDenied or failed_generation errors).
answers.2_ignores_json_mode: Yes, some models fail with failed_generation or invalid parameters, indicating incompatibilities between the prompt size/structure and native constraints.
answers.3_emits_reasoning: Yes, reasoning models (e.g. Qwen 2.5/3 or deepseek derivatives) emit a <think> tag by default in plain completions, which violates native JSON Mode schema.
answers.4_emits_markdown: Yes, Qwen models and gpt-oss-20b frequently output markdown fences (```json ... ```) even when system instructions explicitly forbid them.
answers.5_emits_malformed_json: Yes, models can output trailing commas, unquoted keys, or extra conversational text before or after the JSON payload.
answers.6_prompt_engineering_compatible: YES, for some models prompt engineering works if they respond to strict formatting rules. Let's look at the Test 6 YES/NO results above to verify.
answers.7_needs_model_specific_handling: Yes, RepoGuideAI would benefit from a regex-based JSON extractor/cleaner (similar to LLMService.clean_model_response) to strip <think> and markdown fences before parsing.
